description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 6130016326577 ADAPTER,POWER SUPPL: Line 0001 Qty 311 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0155 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract). Quotes must be submitted electronically.
